reviews.text:
The reception staff, nurses, and the head doctor are all very kind.

This is my second visit, and I find the doctor very trustworthy.

I called the veterinarian outside of regular hours, during the day, because I was worried about my cat's condition. They gave me very kind, clear, and appropriate advice.

My anxiety calmed down, and I was able to think about what to do.

Thank you so much.

There is a truly wonderful doctor.
Six years ago, my two beloved dogs, a Pomeranian and a Japanese Chin, were in critical condition. Dr. Murai performed surgery on them, saving their lives.
He is a kind doctor who always listens attentively and is very supportive.
Thank you so much for everything.
I'm never going to that hospital again!!

My dog ​​suddenly started acting strangely in the middle of the night, and even though I rushed him to the vet without contacting them, they kindly examined him. The doctor is kind, accurate, and a really great doctor.

I thought I'd seen him somewhere before, and it turned out he was the doctor from the emergency vet I used to go to. I'm so grateful for their help both times.

I had never been seen during the daytime, and this was my first time receiving care at night. There can be a bit of a wait if the reception is busy. The nurses and doctor were kind, and although I was worried because I wasn't feeling well at night, I felt reassured.

My dog ​​was coughing and seemed to have trouble breathing in the middle of the night, so I rushed him to the hospital. They examined him immediately, but only took a chest X-ray and gave him a cough suppressant injection, suspecting bronchitis. The next day, a second opinion revealed he was in such a critical condition that he needed to be in an oxygen chamber, and he passed away at 1:35 PM that day. We deeply regret that the misdiagnosis at the emergency hospital prevented our entire family from saying our final goodbyes.

I went to the emergency room at night for the first time (because I was experiencing persistent vomiting).
The doctor's explanations and treatment were incredibly thorough and polite. They explained whether it was an emergency, what to do in this situation, and the fees, which made me feel at ease during the examination.

The reception staff and nurses were also very kind and welcoming. Thank you so much! ⭐︎

They helped me with my cat's emergency.

I was relieved that the result wasn't as bad as I feared.

I had left my main wallet in the countryside and only had a limited amount of money until morning, so I was very worried about whether I could manage. I consulted with them, and I'm very grateful that they kept the tests and treatments to a minimum.

(I had the impression that nighttime visits were prohibitively expensive.)

All the staff were kind and attentive, and their explanations were easy to understand.

My 20-year-old cat developed pleural effusion and was having trouble breathing, so I urgently took her to the vet that night. They examined her carefully and explained what could be done and her current condition in an easy-to-understand way.

They also answered my questions clearly, which put my mind at ease. Thank you so much.
Kind and thorough. I received a good examination. The explanation was clear and easy to understand, which put my mind at ease. Thank you so much.
I was so grateful that you were able to see me for an emergency at night.

My dog ​​may have swallowed a bamboo skewer, so I urgently searched online and brought him to this clinic. They examined him carefully, explained the tests and treatments thoroughly, and allowed me to choose the clinic, which was very kind of them.

My pet accidentally ingested part of a toy late at night, and I received excellent care.

The staff member who initially answered the phone was very polite and made a great first impression. The head veterinarian who examined my pet was also very kind and explained things clearly, which put me at ease. Thank you so much.

My dog's condition suddenly worsened during the night; he couldn't stand and was semi-conscious, so I took him to the vet.

By the time we arrived, he had regained consciousness, but the vet listened carefully to my concerns about his current kidney condition and the IV fluid treatment he received that morning, and explained the possible causes, such as the possibility of nausea due to decreased kidney function.

The vet was very understanding and attentive, checking everything step by step, which put my mind at ease.

After the anti-nausea injection, he seemed a little calmer, and I'm truly grateful.

The fact that they provide consultations without a break from 8 PM to 4 AM is incredibly reassuring.

The consultation fee is a bit high because it's nighttime, but the relief I felt from having him examined was far greater.

I think this is a hospital I can rely on if something happens to my beloved family member.

Thank you for your help with my cat's accidental ingestion.

You explained the potential physical strain on my cat and the costs thoroughly and thoughtfully, which put my mind at ease. Thank you so much.

They kindly listened to my question about whether I should call in the middle of the night.

I'm always unsure about when to go, so their advice was incredibly helpful.

The doctors, nurses, and reception staff were all very kind. Thank you.

I received assistance from your company at night when my dog ​​ingested something harmful.

The response I received when I contacted you by phone was very polite, and you provided prompt treatment, which was a great help.

My child became lethargic and started trembling at night, so I called and they came to help.

The nurses were very kind and helpful. Most importantly, the doctor explained the symptoms and tests thoroughly, and repeatedly asked, "Is there anything else you'd like to ask?" showing great consideration to alleviate my anxiety. They answered all my questions clearly, and even though it became an emergency surgery, I felt completely at ease entrusting them with the care.

It's truly reassuring to know there's a hospital with a doctor like this who can provide care even in the middle of the night.

My dog ​​complained of nausea at night and had eaten some soil from a houseplant, so I brought him to this clinic, which offers after-hours care.
The receptionist I spoke to on the phone before coming was very kind and reassuring.
The head veterinarian explained the treatment and costs thoroughly, so I felt confident leaving my dog ​​in their care.
Thanks to them, my dog's nausea subsided after the IV fluids and prescribed medication, and he is recovering without diarrhea or other symptoms.
It's truly reassuring to know that there are animal hospitals that provide this kind of after-hours care.
I would definitely like to bring my dog ​​here again if needed.
Thank you very much.

My dog ​​suddenly became ill, and I was looking for an emergency veterinary clinic when this one guided me smoothly.

The male doctor was incredibly kind, and I felt he was a gentle doctor, especially in how he spoke to my dog.

The price was reasonable even at night, and because there weren't many people there, everything went smoothly.

Thank you very much! 🙇‍♀️

Thank you so much for your empathetic approach to addressing the owner's anxieties, for the appropriate treatment, and for your clear and easy-to-understand explanations, avoiding technical jargon.

Thank you so much.

My regular doctor's office doesn't offer after-hours appointments, so I came to this clinic.

When I called, they listened carefully to my situation and were very polite. They explained the costs before any tests, since they're more expensive at night, and they performed only the necessary tests, deciding on the next course of action based on the results. I felt completely at ease entrusting my care to them. Thank you.

I took my dog ​​in for an examination because of diarrhea and vomiting.

I had the impression that nighttime hospitals only offered basic first aid, but they provided thorough care. They also prescribed medication.

They took the time to explain the current situation, possible illnesses, and necessary treatments.

The nurses were also very kind to my dog.

After returning home, my dog's condition changed slightly, so I called out of concern, and they responded kindly over the phone as well.

There is a 10,000 yen fee for nighttime consultations, but I would definitely bring him back here if anything else happens.

Thank you!

My cat was going to the litter box multiple times in the middle of the night but wasn't urinating and started to become lethargic, so I took him to the doctor.
He discovered that his urethra was blocked and carefully explained to me the need for treatment, the risks, and even an estimate of the cost. If the condition had continued to worsen, it seemed like it could have been life-threatening.
I was so grateful that he was able to be examined at night.

My pet was bitten in the face by my family's dog, and it was bleeding, so I was really worried as it was nighttime.
Upon arrival, they examined my pet immediately and carried out the necessary treatment efficiently. They also gave thorough explanations, and talked to me about the costs and future progress until I was satisfied.
Thanks to them, it has now healed so beautifully that the scar is barely noticeable.
Thank you so much.

My cat ate a ribbon in the middle of the night, and although he seemed fine, I took him to the hospital just to be sure. During the examination, the doctor explained that it could lead to intestinal obstruction, and they were able to remove it immediately with an endoscope, which was a great help. I'm really grateful that there are hospitals that are open at night.

I was really worried when I had my first seizure at night, but they were able to see me right away and provide immediate treatment. After arriving, they made a quick decision and gave me a quick treatment, and they calmly explained everything to me, which put my mind at ease. They also gave me advice on how to monitor my condition after I got home, which was helpful. I'm now full of energy and able to live my life as normal. I think this is an overnight hospital you can rely on in an emergency.

The other day, my beloved cat ate some chocolate and started having seizures. I called them in a panic, and they were very kind and able to examine him.
There was almost no wait time, they quickly induced him to vomit, and now he's running around happily.
I was prepared for the cost to be high because it was at night, but the director explained the costs and the details of the treatment in great detail, which put me at ease.
Thank you so much.
